articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Enhanced Reasoning and Multimodal Capabilities
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native multimodal input/output across text, image, audio, and video, and a larger context window exceeding 1 million tokens. Benchmarks show substantial gains on graduate-level scientific reasoning and complex code generation tasks, narrowing the gap with specialized domain models.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics Model Demonstrates Zero-Shot Manipulation in Unstructured Environments
articles.summary: DeepMind published results from its Gemini-powered robotics foundation model that achieves zero-shot dexterous manipulation across novel household objects without task-specific fine-tuning. The system leverages a vision-language-action architecture trained on a massive real-world and synthetic dataset, enabling robots to interpret natural language instructions and adapt grasps in real time.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Enters Limited Deployment at Gigafactories
articles.summary: Tesla announced that its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has begun limited operational deployment at two Gigafactories, handling parts sorting, inventory logistics, and light assembly tasks. The Gen 3 model features improved actuator density, a 40% increase in battery endurance, and upgraded onboard inference hardware running Tesla's proprietary vision-language planning stack.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Constitutional Oversight Framework for Enterprise AI Governance
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new enterprise governance framework that allows organizations to define hierarchical constitutional rules for Claude deployments, enabling fine-grained policy enforcement across departments with full audit trails. The framework addresses a growing demand from regulated industries like finance and healthcare for verifiable AI alignment guardrails with deterministic policy adherence.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed it has started volume production on its N1.4 process node, approximately one quarter ahead of its original roadmap, with initial customers including Apple and NVIDIA. The node delivers a 20% performance improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, enabled by next-generation gate-all-around nanosheet transistors and backside power delivery.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source Llama 4 Mixture-of-Experts Model with 1.2 Trillion Parameters
articles.summary: Meta open-sourced Llama 4, a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 1.2 trillion total parameters but only 120 billion active per forward pass, achieving performance competitive with GPT-5 on major benchmarks at significantly lower inference cost. The release includes model weights, training code, and a new RLHF dataset, reinforcing Meta's strategy to commoditize frontier model capabilities.

articles.title: Solid-State Battery Startup QuantumScape Ships First Commercial Cells to Automotive Partners
articles.summary: QuantumScape announced the first commercial shipment of its solid-state lithium-metal battery cells to two major automotive OEMs for integration into 2027 model-year electric vehicles. The cells demonstrate over 800 Wh/L energy density with 15-minute 10-to-80% fast charging and minimal degradation over 1,000 cycles, potentially resolving key EV range and charging anxiety barriers.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment Across European Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Figure AI announced an expanded partnership with BMW to deploy its Figure 02 humanoid robots across three additional European manufacturing plants, scaling from a pilot of 50 units to over 300. The robots handle ergonomically challenging sub-assembly tasks using a transformer-based imitation learning pipeline that allows new task onboarding in under four hours of human demonstration.
